activities.name: Flight to Zurich (LX 41)
activities.notes: In our SWISS Business on the Boeing 777-300ER and the Airbus A340-300, you can convert your seat into a bed over two metres long, and control the seat hardness individually. Additional features for more privacy and space for storing your personal belongings plus a new, easy-to-handle table will make your flight even pleasanter. The 16 inch touch screen provides the best entertainment. On our flights departing from Zurich we serve you seasonal delicacies created by top Swiss chefs, taking you on a journey through the variety of Swiss cuisine. Enjoy the award-winning dishes with multiple courses, or make individual selections at the time of your choosing.

activities.name: Dinner at Veranda NEED TO BOOK
activities.notes: Lakeside dining at the hotel. DRESS CODE: Smart casual for lunch and elegant attire for dinner. Located in the Cardinal’s Building, the fine-dining Veranda restaurant offers glorious views of the lake, gardens and Mosaic. The retractable windows remain open throughout the summer and, weather permitting, diners can savour dinner on the lakeside terrace. Classic and contemporary Italian cuisine is ennobled with international touches. Executive Chef Michele Zambanini blends ceaseless research and the finest ingredients with the utmost respect for seasonal produce. In this formal, elegant setting, guests experience haute cuisine alongside a curated wine selection, in addition to professional service tailored to the desires of every guest.

activities.name: Night Cap at Canova Bar and Lake Terrace
activities.notes: The Canova Bar has been regarded as the most glamorous place to sip a cocktail on Lake Como since 1873. The sumptuous interior make the bar an exclusive spot to people-watch and to be seen at any time of day. Throughout the summer, guests are invited to sit alfresco on the lake terrace, beneath majestic chestnut trees and surrounded by the scent of jasmine.

activities.name: Dinner at Grill NEED TO BOOK
activities.notes: DRESS CODE: Smart casual attire. Located near the Queen’s Pavilion, the Grill is a cosy and casual restaurant. In the summer, guests can dine in the garden beneath the shade of centuries-old trees, while enjoying picturesque lakeside views. Grilled meat and classic fish dishes take centre stage on the menu, alongside a choice of appetizers that showcase Mediterranean culinary traditions centred on the sea and land. Enticing pairings can be found on the wine list and the service is attentive and never pretentious.

activities.name: Dinner at Amador (Amy & Chet)
activities.notes: 3 Michelin-starred tasting menu. We have a table for 2 guests reserved, on Friday 1 August at 7:00 PM. A culinary highlight for the city and for Austria. This restaurant's location on the outskirts of the city in the Hajszan Neumann wine estate is something special in itself. Here, a wonderful brick vaulted ceiling and stylish interior design make for a distinctive look. Juan Amador's cuisine more than lives up to the setting: the finest ingredients are used to create a modern and sophisticated set menu comprising dishes that are finely balanced and consistently harmonious. The creative mastermind of this operation is supported by a highly motivated and pleasingly cordial team. Impressive wine list.
